title: Neonyx Idle is now available on Android
author: Tall-Bicycle5298
selftext:
For those who prefer their games on mobile, Neonyx Idle is finally available on [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.neonyxidle.app&pcampaignid=web_share) but if you prefer to use a browser and nothing to download, there is also the [web version](https://play.neonyxidle.com/). The Guest Log-in function works for those also not wanting to link an e-mail or anything. **Steam and iOS** are coming soon.

Neonyx Idle is following the Melvor formula but with MMORPG community aspects like Factions and party combat. While I did implement a 1v1 dueling mechanic for those wanting to test their builds against one another, I have worked on something for the Factions to hold and fight for.

Territories. 

https://i.redd.it/mjtbn50qqpyh1.png

  
Something else to do rather than infinitely collect resources. Territories can be fought for to give your faction a boost in PvE (It'd be unfair if the buffs were allowed in PvP due to scaling).

This week I spent time adding some music (yes you can mute it), sound effects to give the attacks some feedback and hit effects. 

https://i.redd.it/qyx7cii6wpyh1.png

This is a game you can very much run solo if you want, going at your own pace and not even participating in the PvP as I've designed it to be completely optional, making it friendly towards the casual and the competitive player. 

As for the weapons, there are seven types, with the Synth gloves having 3 element variants, so for the mage players, you have options! Frost, Fire, and Lightning. 

https://i.redd.it/ig0ucilvwpyh1.png

We do have a [Discord ](https://discord.gg/CHNpWxYju)community that is slowly building if you'd like to chime in and chat!
